decisions.reason: The existence summary omitted L>=2 and k(2L-k)>=1. At L=2, k=0.01, s_n=2, every transformed slope is at least 1/4.01>k, so no invariant family can stay in the stated interval. Added precisely the companion lemma hypotheses; cone, slope, orbit and transversality definitions are unchanged.

Step 3.1 had only geometric tails and rules for existing limits. Added thm-cauchy-criterion-via-lub to deps and F4, and explicitly passed the tail estimate to the limit for uniform convergence. Also licensed the reverse triangle estimate with lem-of-triangle-inequality and derived the line action from the matrices in F1. No Statement change or choice assumption.

B_R was introduced only for R>0 although completeness clause 4 also uses B_0. Defined the same formula for every R>=0, with B_0 the zero sequence. Metric weights, relabelling and shift conventions are unchanged. Removed inaccurate publication labels for the current draft binary suppliers.

The cutoff supplier types chi only on (0,1), whereas the Riemann integral needs endpoint values on [0,1]. Zero-extended chi before defining I, explaining smoothness from its compact support. Positivity, normalization, periodic pulse, Hamiltonian convention, maximal domains and time rescaling are preserved.

F6 used the triangle inequality but cited only basic absolute-value properties. Added the published triangle-inequality supplier to deps, roles and F6. Passed signed coordinate inequalities to limits in steps 2.1, 3.1 and 4.1, avoiding an unstated absolute-value limit rule. Completeness and the pullback-metric proof hold also at R=0 without choice.

F1 applied an open-domain mean-value inequality directly on a closed interval. Added cor-mean-value-theorem and applied its exact continuity-on-closed/differentiability-on-open hypotheses to every pair of endpoints; equal endpoints give zero. Added the missing triangle supplier for F4. Banach self-map, unique root, derivative formulas and the existing open C2 extension in step 4.1 remain sound.

The root margins and strict monotonicity require the scalar mean value theorem, absent from deps and F5. Added its published closed-interval supplier and exact hypotheses, and licensed the u+w estimate with the triangle supplier. Verified both signed windows, derivative denominator >=13, 24/27 and 42/27 endpoint margins, orbit residual identity and the existing C2 extension in proof step 5.1. Statement unchanged.

The nonzero P-periodic beta_delta cannot vanish globally outside [pi/2,P]. Restricted the support claim and verification to one period, and stated its global support as the union of period translates of pi/2+delta supp(w). Normalization is the integral on one period. Free rotation, limiting rescaled kick and their exact composition remain unchanged.

F3 incorrectly attributed T_s self-mapping and iterate bounds to the space definition and completeness lemma. Added the already-declared contraction supplier, its clauses 1-3, and the induction from zero that proves every iterate stays in B_R. The finite-window induction, Banach error, continuity modulus and inverse-orbit sign injectivity are unchanged and valid.

F1 explicitly cites proof step 5.1 of lem-perturbed-scalar-recurrence-root-bounds, not merely its C1 Statement. That complete argument supplies open C2 extensions: close-map proof 4.1 constructs open V, quotient differentiation upgrades V to C2, then P is C2, uniform endpoint and derivative margins persist near the compact square, and unique implicit roots glue to C2 maps. Applying the same reasoning to H supplies M^H. Both weighted-tail applications satisfy these hypotheses and their margins. The theorem is unchanged.

L1 omitted L>=2 and 0<k<1 from its restatement of the cone lemma. Restored those hypotheses and the exact weak aperture condition, then checked them at L=sqrt(74), k=1/2 and y=r_+. Also replaced L2 attribution of the surd solution to the contraction lemma with explicit substitution and its actual uniqueness clause. The fixed-slope root and contraction constants are unchanged.

F4 assigned homeomorphism, conjugacy and compactness to suppliers that do not define them. Defined homeomorphism and conjugacy explicitly from metric continuity, added def-metric-compactness and its finite-subcover definition, and retained the exact chaos/hyperbolicity/transversality suppliers. Chose bar C=max(1,C1,C2) so epsilon>0 is explicit. The theorem still transfers both forward/inverse bounds, preserves AC_omega+DC, and has unchanged Statement.

L4 attributed the sign of the coded solution to definitions and square roots instead of contraction clause 4. Cited that already-declared exact supplier; L3 now cites finite-word clause 1 for the explicit constant-code fixed point. Verified the single flip moves from coordinate 0 to -m, coding injectivity excludes orbit periodicity, and the finite-word convergence supplies both tails without compactness or choice.
